Publish a Copilot CLI server container image on release (#5308)

* Publish a Copilot CLI server container image on release

Add a workflow that publishes ghcr.io/github/copilot-cli, an image that runs
the Copilot CLI as a headless server for Copilot SDK clients, whenever a
release is published.

- container/: Dockerfile (checksum-verified release binary, non-root user),
  an entrypoint that requires a connection token, a smoke test that performs
  a real client handshake, and a README.
- publish-container.yml: validates the release, builds and smoke tests each
  architecture on a native runner, pushes by digest, creates the
  multi-platform image with version and channel tags, and attests provenance.
- dependabot: keep the pinned base image up to date.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Update user permissions and ensure service running

Co-authored-by: Copilot Autofix powered by AI <175728472+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Document the container image in the root README

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Fix formatting in README for container image section

* Fix container review findings

Fail closed when an existing channel manifest lacks a version annotation. Trust only the mounted workspace path in Git so repositories owned by another host UID remain usable, and test that case.\n\nCo-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
